missed.fact: Claim 1 has no per-occurrence skip. Snooze is the only per-occurrence store, and it overwrites nextFireAtEpochMillis, the column that already holds the next armed occurrence. The recurrence rule (cronExpr, or the stochastic mask and window) is untouched. No exception-date list or skip-until column exists.

Snooze is a fixed 10 minutes from every surface (notification action, DueNowActivity), with no custom snooze time. Retiming a single occurrence through the UI is therefore limited to 10-minute snoozes.

nextFireAtEpochMillis means two things. For CRON and STOCHASTIC it is the armed next occurrence, and snooze overwrites it. For ONE_SHOT it is the rule itself: nextOneShot reads it as the target. Snoozing a one-shot rewrites its only schedule datum.
The edit screen treats snoozedUntil as an alias for the one-shot time: a one-shot counts as unchanged if the form time equals nextFireAt OR snoozedUntil.

The edit screen preserves a live snooze only while the schedule fields are unchanged. The snooze becomes both nextFire and snoozedUntil. A changed schedule, or a snooze already in the past, drops it and recomputes. A STOCHASTIC draw is also kept while unchanged and still in the future.

Merge hazard: snooze overwrites the next occurrence that recordFired had already armed. When the snooze fires, recordFired recomputes from now (CRON) or from midnight tomorrow (STOCHASTIC). A cron occurrence falling between the fire and the snooze end is silently lost. A stochastic draw for tomorrow is redrawn, not kept.

snooze() also sets isArchived=false, because recordFired archives a fired one-shot while its notification is still showing. isArchived is deletion tombstone, done, and spent-one-shot all at once, which matters for the merged deletion column.

Identity and deletion columns: id is a client UUID primary key. isArchived is the soft delete and the sync tombstone. updatedAtEpochMillis drives conflict detection, and ReminderSyncManager rejects non-UUID ids.
Done on a recurring reminder (completeOccurrence) does not advance or skip anything. It only clears the snooze, leaving nextFireAt as recordFired already set it. Done on a ONE_SHOT always archives.
Enum cases beyond the map's scope: ScheduleType has ONE_SHOT as a third case, and ReminderMode (EASE, SCHEDULE, ALERT) is a separate enum.

absence_probes.pattern: skip, feature hits only (the 11 are comments about double-delivery, sync-file parsing, the battery prompt and icon_check; none is a skip-occurrence feature)
